# Albuquerque Public Schools (APS)

> > Albuquerque Public Schools serves New Mexico's largest school district with comprehensive K-12 education, student services, and family resources.

APS operates numerous schools across Albuquerque and surrounding areas including specialized programs like the Career Enrichment Center, Early College Academy, and APS International High School. The district provides centralized student services through ParentVUE, registration support, and the Berna Facio Professional Development Center.

## Key Topics

- Albuquerque Public Schools (APS)
- Student services and registration
- School calendars and schedules
- ParentVUE and family resources
- High schools (Del Norte, APS International)
- Career Enrichment Center
- Early College Academy
- APS Board of Education
- Student meals and transcripts
- Athletics programs
- Internationals Network
- Community schools (Tres Volcanes)
- Professional development (Berna Facio Center)
- SAT and college readiness

## Students & Families

- [Students & Families](https://www.aps.edu/students-parents): Student handbook, meals, calendars, transcripts & family resources hub
- [Student, Parent, and Employee Service Center](https://www.aps.edu/service-center): APS customer service for transfers, registration & ParentVUE support

- [APS International High School](https://aihs.aps.edu/): APS International High School homepage with Internationals Network info
